## Provider completion rules

| Provider | Terminal success |
| --- | --- |
| wormhole-ntt | A successful source receipt is necessary but insufficient; completion requires a successful destination receipt with TransferRedeemed for the same NTT transfer digest. |
| mezo-native-bridge | A successful source receipt is necessary but insufficient. Use the direction-specific delivery proof in native-lifecycle.json. |

MUSD NTT completion is the `successful destination receipt with TransferRedeemed for the source NTT digest`.

Native inbound and outbound completion remain direction-specific across 2 models. An inbound system receipt or sequence advance alone is not ERC-20 delivery proof.

## Production boundary

The evidence review covers the recorded providers, assets, transfer traces and contract generations. Private transfer and observer implementations exist in the SDK, but supported route release requires its own operation review. There is no relayer or automatic delivery service. Resolve a new transfer's current configuration and preconditions; an address or completed historical transfer does not establish present availability.

Remaining blockers:

- current exact-call writer verification for any future supported route

## Private Native source and current delivery

The [Native source qualification](../evidence/native-transfer-2026-09-15.json) remains `proposed` / `accepted`.

It combines current read-only bridge/token evidence, pinned source and historical transfer compatibility for the two initial routes. The [Bridges SDK](../../../../packages/bridges/REFERENCE.md#private-native-source-preparation) owns the implemented API, exact source simulation and separate destination observation. Confirmed failed payouts require governance recovery; destination fee estimates cannot cap a later settlement fee.
